hollow_crypt.name: The Hollow Crypt

gates.name: Undercroft Grille
gates.openText: The Undercroft Grille grinds open.

gates.name: Bone Barrier
gates.openText: The bone barrier before the Bell Yard crumbles.

gates.name: Frost-Web Curtain
gates.openText: The frost-web curtain tears apart.

gates.name: Webbed Causeway
gates.openText: The webs over the eastern causeway fall away.

gates.name: Twin Seals
gates.openText: Both sigils gutter out. The Twin Seals open.

gates.name: Choir Door
gates.openText: The choir door opens onto the Bone Stair.

gates.name: Bone Stair Gate
gates.openText: The gate at the foot of the Bone Stair collapses.

hollow_crypt.enterText: You descend into the Hollow Crypt...

sunken_bastion.name: The Sunken Bastion

gates.name: Sea Gate
gates.openText: Chains shriek in the fog. The Sea Gate grinds open.

gates.name: Bailey Drawbridge
gates.openText: The drawbridge crashes down over the ditch.

gates.name: Rampart Door
gates.openText: The Rampart Door lifts onto the Breach Bastion.

gates.name: Postern Fog Wall
gates.openText: The fog over the Postern Stair parts.

gates.name: Gaol Grate
gates.openText: The Gaol Grate rattles up into the rock.

gates.name: Keep Stair Chain
gates.openText: The chain grate at the Keep Stair winds up.

gates.name: Beacon Ward
gates.openText: The fog on the beacon stair thins to nothing.

sunken_bastion.enterText: You wade down into the Sunken Bastion...
sunken_bastion.leaveText: You climb out of the drowning dark.

gravewyrm_sanctum.name: Gravewyrm Sanctum

gates.name: Rime Gate
gates.openText: The Rime Gate cracks from top to bottom and crashes down in a storm of ice.

gates.name: West Chain Stair
gates.openText: Both wings fall silent. The grates of the Chain Stairs rise on groaning chains.

gates.name: Chain Bridge
gates.openText: A slack chain as thick as a mast falls across the gulf and pulls taut: the Smith's chain is the way down.

gates.name: Vault Ward
gates.openText: The Vault Ward gutters out. Below, the thaw pyres roar.

gates.name: Tithe Gate
gates.openText: With the rite broken, the Tithe Gate shatters. The shore of the held lies open.

gates.name: Hollow Ward
gates.openText: The Hollow Ward fails. On the lake, the ice groans under the Wyrm's weight.

gravewyrm_sanctum.enterText: The air goes cold. Something vast breathes below...
gravewyrm_sanctum.leaveText: You stagger back into the mountain wind.

nythraxis_crypt.name: Abandoned Crypt
nythraxis_crypt.enterText: You cross the threshold of the Abandoned Crypt.
nythraxis_crypt.leaveText: You return to the cold air of Thornpeak.

the_last_keep.name: The Last Keep
the_last_keep.enterText: You step into the cold, silent halls of the Last Keep.
the_last_keep.leaveText: You pull the keep door shut and step back into the Drakelands wind.

dawnhold_castle.name: Dawnhold Castle
dawnhold_castle.enterText: You step into the warm, flower-scented halls of Dawnhold Castle.
dawnhold_castle.leaveText: You slip back out onto the sunlit garden lawn.

nythraxis_boss_arena.name: Nythraxis Raid Arena
nythraxis_boss_arena.enterText: You pass through the sealed royal door.
nythraxis_boss_arena.leaveText: You return to the cold air of Thornpeak.

ignivar_forge_lift.name: The Forge-Lift
ignivar_forge_lift.enterText: The forge-lift shudders and sinks; hammerfall rises to meet you.
ignivar_forge_lift.leaveText: The lift hauls you back into the open air of the keep.

ignivar_forge_approach.name: Halls of the First Tempering
ignivar_forge_approach.enterText: Hammerfall echoes through the Halls of the First Tempering.
ignivar_forge_approach.leaveText: You step away from the first forge and breathe freely again.

ignivar_raid_arena.name: Crucible of the Last Spring
ignivar_raid_arena.enterText: Heat shimmers above the sealed waters of the Crucible.
ignivar_raid_arena.leaveText: You step away from the Crucible and breathe freely again.

ignivar_molten_assembly.name: Molten Assembly
ignivar_molten_assembly.enterText: The opened gate leads into a molten assembly hall.
ignivar_molten_assembly.leaveText: You leave the assembly line and return to the Crucible.

ignivar_inner_crucible.name: The Inner Crucible
ignivar_inner_crucible.enterText: The opened gate leads deeper into the Crucible.
ignivar_inner_crucible.leaveText: You leave the silent depths of the Crucible.

drowned_temple.name: The Drowned Temple

gates.name: Choir Veil
gates.openText: The curtain of falling water over the Choir Stair parts.

gates.name: West Court Stair
gates.openText: The choir falls silent. The Court Stairs unward.

gates.name: Sunken Prism Stair
gates.openText: The moon pool drains with a roar. The Prism Stair rises from the lagoon.

gates.name: Prism Ward
gates.openText: The ward on the Prism Terrace fades.

gates.name: The Moonbridge
gates.openText: Moonlight gathers over the lagoon and hardens into a bridge.

gates.name: Altar Ward
gates.openText: The rite ward before the Moon Altar breaks.

drowned_temple.enterText: You step through the moongate: the air turns to cold water and pale light, and the singing closes over your head.
drowned_temple.leaveText: You surface through the moongate into the mountain night.

wildheart_basin.name: The Wildheart Basin

gates.name: West Vine Bridge
gates.openText: With the ford cleared, the vines stir and weave two bridges across the gorge.

gates.name: Beast Pits Thorn Wall
gates.openText: The thorn hedge before the Beast Pits withers back into the earth.

gates.name: Weeping Falls Thorn Wall
gates.openText: The thorns at the foot of the Weeping Falls shrink away from the path.

gates.name: Sunbone Causeway Thorn Wall
gates.openText: With the Beastmaster and the Gorgebloom fallen, the thorns on the Sunbone Causeway recede.

gates.name: Convergence Stair Ward
gates.openText: The ward across the Convergence Stair flickers and fails.

gates.name: Shrine Ward
gates.openText: The Shrine Ward falls. Above the terrace, the stone jaguar watches.

wildheart_basin.enterText: You step through the idol maw onto a ledge high above the basin. Waterfalls thunder from the rim, and far below, something enormous wades the ford.
wildheart_basin.leaveText: You pass back beneath the stone fangs into the Palmreach sun.
